description: This file contains functions for controlling and retrieving information about LEDs in an embedded Linux environment, specifically on systems that use device trees and sysfs interfaces for LED control. It provides mechanisms for getting LED device paths, setting LED attributes, and managing LED states such as on, off, blinking, and heartbeat.

methods.name: get_dt_led_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device tree path for a given LED identifier.

methods.name: get_dt_led_color_func
methods.description: Determines the color label or function of an LED based on device tree properties.

methods.name: get_dt_led
methods.description: Gets a human-readable label for an LED device based on device tree or sysfs attributes.

methods.name: led_set_attr
methods.description: Sets a specified attribute for a given LED via sysfs.

methods.name: led_timer
methods.description: Configures an LED to act as a timer with on/off delays.

methods.name: led_on
methods.description: Turns an LED on by setting brightness to maximum.

methods.name: led_off
methods.description: Turns an LED off by setting brightness to zero.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for a status LED from device tree.

methods.name: status_led_set_timer
methods.description: Sets a status LED to blink with specified on/off durations.

methods.name: status_led_set_heartbeat
methods.description: Sets a status LED to heartbeat mode.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit
methods.description: Sets up slow blinking as pre-initialization.

methods.name: status_led_blink_failsafe
methods.description: Sets up fast blinking for failsafe mode.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit_regular
methods.description: Sets up regular blinking during pre-initialization.
